name: AAC - Test Practices and Emails Preview

parameters.formDescription: Enter test-only practices and recipients. This does not save, launch, email, or publish anything.

values.fieldLabel: Test practices (one Name | public website URL per line; URL optional)
Test emails (one email | practice name per line; practice optional if one practice)

parameters.content:
## Test-only preview

Enter practice names/public websites and email recipients without touching the production roster. The workflow contains no BigQuery, Gmail, HTTP, or WordPress nodes, and stays inactive. Attach a dedicated Basic Auth credential after import. No entries are persisted.
